import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Arrays;

import javax.imageio.ImageIO;

import net.coobird.thumbnailator.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.geometry.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.name.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.configurations.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.exif.*;

public final class ApiTest {
    private ApiTest() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String grid_png = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.png";
    String grid_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.jpg";
    String exif_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Exif/original.jpg";
    String output_dir = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/.aideal_exec/B2/output";

    // pre-loaded typed inputs (comprehension.execute.preamble)
    BufferedImage sourceImage = new BufferedImage(32, 24, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    Graphics2D graphics = sourceImage.createGraphics();
    graphics.setColor(Color.BLUE);
    graphics.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 24);
    graphics.setColor(Color.YELLOW);
    graphics.fillRect(8, 6, 16, 12);
    graphics.dispose();
    BufferedImage destinationImage = new BufferedImage(16, 12, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    ByteArrayOutputStream imageBytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    Path outputPath = Paths.get(output_dir, "thumbnail.png");
    Files.createDirectories(outputPath.getParent());

            // TODO API_TEST_START
            java.nio.file.Path testFilePath = outputPath.resolve("test_overwrite.png");
            java.nio.file.Files.write(testFilePath, new byte[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5});

            // Test that allowOverwrite(true) successfully overwrites the existing file
            net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails.of(sourceImage)
                .size(10, 10)
                .allowOverwrite(true)
                .toFile(testFilePath.toFile());

            long newSize = java.nio.file.Files.size(testFilePath);
            assert newSize > 5 : "File should have been overwritten with a valid image, but size was " + newSize;

            // Test the documented failure mode: calling allowOverwrite multiple times throws IllegalStateException
            boolean threw = false;
            try {
                net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails.of(sourceImage)
                    .size(10, 10)
                    .allowOverwrite(true)
                    .allowOverwrite(false);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                threw = true;
            }
            assert threw : "Should throw IllegalStateException when allowOverwrite is called multiple times";

            System.out.println("__CHECK__ allowOverwrite " + newSize + "_" + threw);
            // TODO API_TEST_END
            System.out.println("__DONE__");
        } catch (Throwable exc) {
            System.err.println("__RUN_ERR__ " + exc.getClass().getSimpleName()
                    + ": " + exc.getMessage());
            exc.printStackTrace(System.err);
            System.exit(1);
        }
    }
}
